reason: My guests come back because they talk to me, not a machine. I answer at night, in my bad German, and they remember that. With €150 setup plus €35 a month, I would pay to push my guests away from me.
objection: A guest who scans a QR code and gets a robot will feel the host does not care. Personal contact is the reason my reviews are good, and with my income every euro has to bring something back.
would_change_my_mind: If another host I know here showed me that their guests still wrote good reviews about the personal welcome, and it only took the boring Wi-Fi and parking questions off my phone in August, at maybe €15 a month with no setup fee.
